name: pulsar_step_duration
description: Duration in ms of each step inside a search (cache_lookup, query_rewrite, inspire_search, web_fallback, deferred_papers, llm_provider_succeeded).
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="pulsar-backend" AND jsonPayload.message=("cache_lookup" OR "query_rewrite" OR "inspire_search" OR "web_fallback" OR "deferred_papers" OR "llm_provider_succeeded")
